response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Nest.js, and has contributed to scalable platforms supporting millions of requests. His background includes database systems (MongoDB, PostgreSQL-like experience via RDS), cloud infrastructure (AWS CDK, Kubernetes), and clean software architecture. However, his recent roles skew heavily toward senior-level responsibilities, and his focus on AI-agent infrastructure may not align perfectly with the pragmatic energy/construction tech stack required.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and fullstack development experience with React and Node.js
Proven track record in scalable systems (handling millions of requests, AWS, Kubernetes)
Diverse industry exposure including energy, construction, and geospatial tech
concerns: May be overqualified for a junior/mid-level role given senior-level titles and responsibilities
Recent focus on AI-agent infrastructure (LLM, MCP) may not directly translate to energy/construction tech needs
Limited explicit PostgreSQL experience (mostly MongoDB/RDS; PostgreSQL is mentioned in job description as preferred)

key_factors.factor: Potential over-qualification / misalignment with role seniority
